title: Starfall Command
description:
Humanity's last hope stands between the galaxy and total annihilation.

Take control of one of four unique starfighters and fight through relentless waves of enemy forces, elite squadrons, deadly mini-bosses, and massive war machines.

Master fast-paced arcade combat, dodge enemy fire, unleash devastating homing missile attacks, and challenge the ultimate AI threat known only as THE OVERMIND.

FEATURES

• 4 playable starfighters including a secret unlockable ship

• Fast-paced arcade space shooter gameplay

• Multiple enemy types with unique behaviors

• Elite waves and mini-boss encounters

• Massive boss battles with unique music themes

• Homing missile mega attack system

• Endless mode after campaign completion

• Full keyboard controls

• Original Eagle Pulse Games studio intro

Can you survive long enough to defeat the Overmind and save the galaxy?
description_short: Pilot powerful starfighters, battle massive bosses, unleash devastating homing missiles, and defeat the Overmind in this fast-paced arcade sci-fi shoot 'em up.
